description: Replace the entire decay-heat exercise with the approved control-rod and continued-cooling question, without supplying its explanation in the prompt.

changes.before: <para id="import-auto-id3037642">The core of a nuclear reactor generates a large amount of thermal energy from the decay of fission products, even when the power-producing fission chain reaction is turned off. Would this residual heat be greatest after the reactor has run for a long time or short time? What if the reactor has been shut down for months?</para>
changes.after: <para id="import-auto-id3037642">Control rods stop the self-sustaining fission chain reaction in a nuclear reactor, but the reactor still requires cooling. Explain the source of the continuing energy release and why inserting the control rods does not stop it.</para>
